test_title: PYST 27: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: If 22 March 2000 is a Wednesday, then what will the day of the week on 16th January 2010?
solution: Given: **22 March 2000** was Wednesday. Now, 2000 to 2009 = 9 Years (7 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Years). And, In 9 Years = 2 Leap years and 7 Ordinary Years. So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days, And, 7 Ordinary Years have 7 odd days. Total odd days = 4 + 7 = 11.
